_: Step 11, row 11.4 (2026-11-26): the apps' drawings — the empty screens, a kitchen without a photo, a reward won — in the icons' line. Each drawing: its kind (vacio, oficio, premio), its size in points as the pictures are drawn (render-dibujos.sh), its ink as a palette token (brand/mostrador/paleta.json), and where it sits: the screen's file, a text that file must still contain, the sentence beside it as a key of that app's strings.ts, and what the screen shows there today. dibujos.mjs checks every entry against the code. No app reads this folder until row 11.10.

reglas.vacio: A drawing only where a whole screen, or its one list, has nothing yet: never while it loads, without signal, on a failure, or when a search matched nothing.
